title: Store each Eva entry once per day with its writer
goal: A written Eva entry is kept per day with the writer (model name or template), language and time, and is not regenerated
acceptance: A failing test (committed first): after a day is written, reading the chronicle returns the stored text and its writer; asking again does not call the model; the Italian and English entries are stored separately
The stored record holds day, language, text, writer (model id or template), grounded, fallback and written-at; no prompt text and no conversation content
The Simple version never reads this store, so the lore cannot reach the plain record; a join test across store, composer and the CLI shows both versions for the same day
The owner can ask for one day to be rewritten explicitly (replaces the stored entry); never automatic
privacy: Neutral invented bases, pilots, sorties and days only; no owner data, tokens or real conversation text in Git, tests or logs.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one small table or record kind and a read path, plus the join test. Not a measurement.
